products.name: Norrland Oval Coffee Table
products.short_description: Oval solid-oak coffee table with softly tapered legs and a low, calm profile.
products.description: A 120 cm oval top in FSC solid oak, hand-finished with a natural oil that keeps the grain visible and matte. The rounded silhouette removes hard corners from the centre of the room, which makes it forgiving in tight seating arrangements and in homes with small children.
products.care: Wipe with a damp cloth; re-oil once a year.

products.name: Halden Nesting Coffee Tables (Set of 2)
products.short_description: Two stackable lacquered tables that split apart when you need more surface.

products.care: Non-abrasive cleaner only; lacquer scratches under grit.

products.name: Fabrik Forge Coffee Table
products.short_description: Reclaimed pine top on a welded black steel frame with a lower storage shelf.

products.care: Re-wax annually; wipe spills immediately, reclaimed pine is porous.

products.name: Bellucci Round Marble Coffee Table
products.short_description: Honed Carrara marble disc on a brushed brass pedestal.

products.name: Kiona Rattan Coffee Table
products.short_description: Square mango-wood frame with a woven cane lower deck.

products.name: Aero Glass Coffee Table
